cohort: The study included 5,196 breastfeeding mothers from the Indian state of Jharkhand.
finding: The overall prevalence of delayed breastfeeding initiation in Jharkhand was 77.1%, with poor economic background and caesarean deliveries significantly increasing the odds of delayed initiation, while institutional deliveries reduced the odds.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries were associated with significantly increased odds of delayed breastfeeding initiation (aOR = 2.325, p < 0.001).
